prompt: Complete a Car class that is composed of the provided Engine: delegate start and isRunning to the engine, and implement drive(km), which burns 0.5 fuel per km through the engine but only while it is running.
explanation: Car does not extend Engine -- a car is not an engine, it has one. The Car constructor builds its own Engine and the simple pass-through methods (start, isRunning, getFuel) are called delegation. drive adds car-level behavior on top: it checks the engine state before asking it to consume fuel, and the engine itself enforces the shut-off-when-empty rule, so each class owns its own invariant.
hints: Declare private Engine engine; and assign this.engine = new Engine(fuel); in the constructor.
start(), isRunning(), and getFuel() each just call the matching engine method and return its result.
In drive, first check engine.isRunning(); if true, call engine.consumeFuel(km * 0.5).
